ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:name: efuse_mmr
ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:description: Security-token input and match-status registers for RMA and secure-disable eFuse tokens.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RMA_SIP_TOKEN_I
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Software-writeable RMA token word. The assembled token is hashed and compared against the fused value to authorize lifecycle (LC) state transitions.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: token
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Portion of writeable version of RMA_*_TOKEN, hashed, and compared with fused value to allow LC to change states.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RMA_CHIPLET_TOKEN_I
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Software-writeable RMA token word. The assembled token is hashed and compared against the fused value to authorize lifecycle (LC) state transitions.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: token
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Portion of writeable version of RMA_*_TOKEN, hashed, and compared with fused value to allow LC to change states.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SEC_DISABLE_TOKEN_I
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Software-writeable security-disable token word. The assembled token is hashed and compared against the post-silicon injected value to authorize security_disable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: token
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Portion of writeable version of SEC_DISABLE_TOKEN, hashed, and compared with the post silicon injected values to allow security_disable.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TOKEN_EOP
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Token end-of-packet control. Writing the per-token go bit signals that all token words have been written and triggers a pulse to begin token hashing.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rma_sip_token_go
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to indicate that all token data has been written; this generates a pulse to begin token hashing.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rma_chiplet_token_go
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to indicate that all token data has been written; this generates a pulse to begin token hashing.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: secure_disable_token_go
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to indicate that all token data has been written; this generates a pulse to begin token hashing.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RMA_SIP_TOKEN_MATCH
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Token match status. Reports the result of the token hash comparison (match, mismatch, or error).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: token_match_status
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Store the status of the token match. Match = 6'b010101, Mismatch = 6'b101010, Error = 6'b111111

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RMA_CHIPLET_TOKEN_MATCH
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Token match status. Reports the result of the token hash comparison (match, mismatch, or error).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: token_match_status
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Store the status of the token match. Match = 6'b010101, Mismatch = 6'b101010, Error = 6'b111111

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SEC_DISABLE_TOKEN_MATCH
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Token match status. Reports the result of the token hash comparison (match, mismatch, or error).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: token_match_status
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Store the status of the token match. Match = 6'b010101, Mismatch = 6'b101010, Error = 6'b111111

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TOKEN_MATCH_FAULT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Token comparator redundancy fault status. The token match logic is triple redundant and is not a majority vote: all three comparators must agree and each must drive a legal differential pair. A bit sets when the comparators for that token disagree, which may indicate a fault injection or FIB attack. The corresponding token_match_status then reads the error code 6'b111111 and an interrupt is raised to the SEP CPU. Bits are sticky until reset.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rma_sip_token_fault
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: A redundancy fault was detected in the RMA_SIP_TOKEN comparators.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rma_chiplet_token_fault
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: A redundancy fault was detected in the RMA_CHIPLET_TOKEN comparators.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: secure_disable_token_fault
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: A redundancy fault was detected in the SEC_DISABLE_TOKEN comparators.
